title: SimulatorMessageAndMinimapWiring - the 800x600 simulator data now carries the decoded network layer (frame_dispatch: jump table, pump dispatch, queue item anatomy, base64 encoder) and the corrected minimap anatomy (widget 0x48512C D3D target rect byte-exact vs simulator map.minimap {672,0,800,128}); build script Tools/web/build_mir3_simulator_data.py regenerates all data/*.json from evidence
objective: Wire Round 10's network-decoding findings into the simulator data pipeline: extend frame_tables.json with the frame-dispatch block (12-row jump table, large-type chain, queue pump semantics per msgid, queue item layout, MIR base64 encoder contract) and extend hud.json's minimap entry with the full corrected F310 anatomy, then regenerate data/*.json and verify the consumers (app.js) still bind.
question: How does the simulator consume frame_tables and the minimap data, and does the regenerated data preserve those contracts while adding the new decoded knowledge?
method: Edit Tools/web/build_mir3_simulator_data.py (canonical generator) - hud.json minimap note extended to full F310 anatomy; frame_tables() gained 'frame_dispatch' block; re-run python3 Tools/web/build_mir3_simulator_data.py; verify regenerated JSON (keys, row counts, minimap rect) and app.js consumer lines (frame_tables entity state names ~75/145-146; minimap cycle key hud.minimap ~982, draw 1007-1014).
